waves.label: L8 acceptance test expansion — Retro
waves.notes: 28 lines -> 90+ lines. Added: L8 corpus gate check, period declaration (default 10, --period N, --since date), required document structure (all 8 sections), chain health classification (INTACT/BROKEN/FAIL status), observation-only language constraint (banned: should/must/recommend/fix; required: observed/occurred/was present), wave summary accuracy, memory enrichment with drawer references, recurring pattern detection (threshold: 3 occurrences), unresolved gaps carry-forward, Not Tested section required non-empty, idempotency, dry-run.

waves.label: L8 acceptance test expansion — Feedback
waves.notes: 45 lines -> 90+ lines. Added: L8 corpus gate check, --metrics flag required (surfaces error without it), --metrics cost,budget=N (budget target + over-budget flagging), latency p50/p95, trend analysis (improving/degrading/stable/insufficient_data), first-run message, analysis period (default all, --period 30d, insufficient-data warning at <5 receipts), dry-run (still shows duplicate warnings).

waves.label: L8 acceptance test expansion — Factory
waves.notes: 45 lines -> 100+ lines. Added: L8 corpus gate check, stub version tracking (factory_version in skill-rules.json, factory_generated_at in SKILL.md frontmatter), stub content validation per file (SKILL.md: [FILL] markers with hints not bare; skill-rules.json: layer/authority/verification_mode from blueprint not [FILL]; receipt.schema.json: valid JSON Schema with 4 base fields; tests/acceptance.md: 3+ Given/When/Then placeholders), dry-run (idempotency guard does not fire on dry-run).
